findings_addressed.category: N8 existence-only for a behavior test
findings_addressed.oracle: The pattern source `_PRINT_PATTERN` declares `u8 __mark @ __ping();` — the real HexPat interpreter must return a field list containing a field whose name includes `__mark`. This is verified by inspecting the pattern AST independently: the `u8 __mark` declaration is the sole top-level typed variable, so any correct evaluation must emit exactly that named field. The `assert fields` plus `any('__mark' in name ...)` check uses the pattern source text as the independent oracle.

falsifiability.mutation: fields: list[dict[str, Any]] = interpreter.execute(source, self.document, offset) -> fields: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

findings_addressed.category: N8 existence/type-only check for a behavior test
findings_addressed.oracle: Independent oracle: a direct call to `execute_pattern(_PRINT_PATTERN)` returns `direct_fields`. The `execute_pattern_with_output` wrapper must return a `fields` list whose length equals `len(direct_fields)` AND which contains a field whose name includes `__mark` (the sole top-level typed variable declared in `_PRINT_PATTERN`). The field-name check uses the pattern source as the oracle; the length cross-check uses the raw `execute_pattern` result as a second independent oracle.

falsifiability.mutation: In `execute_pattern_with_output`, change `fields: list[dict[str, Any]] = await self.execute_pattern(source, offset, print_sink=captured.append)` to `fields: list[dict[str, Any]] = []` — the `len(fields) == len(direct_fields)` assertion fails because `direct_fields` is non-empty.
